description: Airport Property is a dataset listed in City of Casey's Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Casey. This dataset provides information about locations of airports in the City of Casey. Coverage: City of Casey, Victoria. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are Transport, Airport, Aviation, Aircraft, Airports. The portal shows 2 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-casey-vic-gov-au-portal.
